renderingHints.childOrder: Children render in the order of properties.childOrder (an array of child component ids); grid top/left of a child are ignored. A child missing from childOrder lands after the listed ones in an arbitrary order. MCP writes childOrder: request order when the container and its children are created together, appended for a child added or reparented later.
renderingHints.childWidth: A child fills the free main-axis width by default (layouts.desktop.fillWidth true). Fill children in a row share the line: equally by default, or by layouts.desktop.grow (grow 2 beside grow 1 takes two thirds). layouts.desktop.minWidthPx is the narrowest a fill child may get; in a row with properties.flexWrap {{true}} a child that would go narrower wraps to the next line (a responsive card grid). For a fixed width set fillWidth=false and widthPx=<pixels>. The grid width/left are still required by the API but do not change the rendered width.
renderingHints.childHeight: A child is its authored layout height in px. Only a child with its own dynamicHeight on grows to its content (in view mode). In a row with properties.alignItems "stretch", child FlexContainers (cards) fill the line's height so sibling cards share one height; other children keep their own height. alignItems "last baseline" lines up the last text line of each child (a labelled field's value, a badge, a button label).
renderingHints.containerHeight: With properties.dynamicHeight {{true}} the container grows to fit its children in view mode; the editor keeps the authored height. Without it, children beyond the authored height (padding included) are cut off.
renderingHints.shadcnCard: cardStyle 'shadcnCard' draws a ToolJet UI 2.0 card: a light surface with a 14px radius, a 1px border and a faint shadow, plus a header with cardTitle (semibold) and cardExtra as a muted description beneath it. The header takes 48px with a title only and 70px with a description, from the body. Pair it with the Shad* widgets.
renderingHints.spacing: padding and gap are properties in px, not styles.
renderingHints.surface: A FlexContainer is pure layout and is created transparent (no background, no border) unless you give it a surface: cardStyle 'shadcnCard' (a ToolJet UI 2.0 card with optional cardTitle/cardExtra header) or your own backgroundColor/borderColor. Add a surface only where you want one; rows and columns used for layout stay invisible.

authoringHints.creation: Create the container and its children in one add_components call: the container gets a client_ref, each child the matching parent_ref, listed in display order. Children may share the same top/left (for example 0,0): flex children are not linted for overlap.
authoringHints.reorder: Reorder with update_components on the container: definition.properties.childOrder = [child names or ids] in the wanted order; children left out keep their relative order after the listed ones.
authoringHints.childOrderManaged: Do not author childOrder ids on create; MCP fills them in. A childOrder given on create may name batch children by client_ref or name.

Pins are coloured by status: by its words (Delivered or Done green, Delayed or Pending amber, Failed or Overdue red, Open, Scheduled or In transit blue; or a tone name success | warning | danger | info), or by statusColors ({ 'Under offer': '#d97706', Open: 'warning' }); showLegend (on) lists the colours with counts. labelField puts a short value in the pin (a stop number) or, longer, a price pill ('€450k'); iconField puts a lucide icon in the pin ('snowflake', 'droplets', 'zap'); markerIcon sets one icon for every pin (iconField wins per row). headingField (degrees, 0 north, clockwise) turns the icon or image to where a vehicle is going, best with 'navigation' or 'plane'. imageField shows an image per row (an https URL, a path or a data URI, SVG included; it should point north for heading) instead of the pin, with a ring of its status colour; a broken or unsafe URL keeps the pin. markerSize: small, medium (default) or large. Routes: connectMarkers draws a line through the markers in routeOrderField order, one per routeField value (a driver, a van), from routeStart (a depot { lat, lng }) when given; routes (a second dataset) draws lines from rows { name, path: [[lat, lng], ...] or a GeoJSON LineString, color or status }; routeColors names each line's colour. Areas (zones, territories, geofences): areas rows with an outline (areaShapeField: [[lat, lng], ...], a GeoJSON Polygon or its JSON text) or a circle (lat, lng and areaRadiusField in metres), titled by areaTitleField and filled by areaStatusField's tone (or the row's color). A click on a marker selects it (selectedMarker: its row, selectedMarkerId), opens a popup with the title, status and popupFields (a comma list of field specs as the Record list's metaFields: 'driver', 'eta:ETA {}', 'total|currency'; showPopup off for none) and fires onMarkerClick; a click on a line or area exposes selectedShape (its row) and selectedShapeType ('route' | 'area') and fires onShapeClicked; a click on the map clears the selection, exposes clickedLocation { lat, lng } and fires onMapClicked. pickLocation lets the user click (or drag a pin) to choose a spot: pickedLocation { lat, lng, address } and onLocationPicked (defaultPickedLocation starts it); showSearch adds an address search box (OpenStreetMap Nominatim by default, rate-limited; geocoderUrl and reverseGeocoderUrl, with {query} or {lat} and {lng}, point it at another geocoder). display 'heat' (or 'both') draws density instead of pins, weighted by heatField. clusterMarkers groups crowded pins into counts (on by default; keeps thousands of rows smooth). fitToMarkers (on by default) opens on everything drawn and refits when data changes; off, the map opens on defaultCenter ({ lat, lng }, [lat, lng] or 'lat, lng') at defaultZoom (1 to 18; 12 is a city, 15 a street). scrollWheelZoom is off by default (the page scrolls past the map; Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel zooms); showFullscreen adds a fullscreen button; mapStyle 'satellite' shows imagery and showStyleSwitch a Map | Satellite toggle. Exposes center, zoom and bounds after every move; onBoundsChange fires when the user pans or zooms. Actions: setCenter(lat, lng, zoom), setZoom, fitBounds, selectMarker(id), clearSelection, setPickedLocation(lat, lng), clearPickedLocation, setMapStyle('streets' | 'satellite'). Height: fixed (the map fills it); give it 320 to 640px

authoringHints.look: styles.tableLook "shadcn" draws this Table in the ToolJet UI 2.0 look (card frame, search-first toolbar, quiet header, hairline rows, UI 2.0 buttons and pagination); use it for tables in apps built in ToolJet UI 2.0. Properties, columns, row action buttons, events and exposed values are the Table's own in both looks.
authoringHints.rowActionDisplay: In the UI 2.0 table look a button column takes buttonDisplay: 'icons' (32px ghost icon buttons, the label as tooltip) for one to three actions every row needs at a glance (View, Edit, Delete), or 'menu' (one '...' button at the row's right edge opening a dropdown) for three or more actions or rarely used ones; 'buttons' (default) keeps labelled buttons, for a single primary row action ('Check in', 'Approve'). Icons come from buttonIconName with buttonIconVisibility true, else from the label's verb (Edit pencil, Delete trash, View eye, Approve check, Send, Export, Copy, Archive...): give every button a short verb label. Delete, Remove and Reject draw in the destructive colour, set apart at the end of the menu. Events, rowData bindings (buttonVisibility, disableButton) and selectedRow work as for labelled buttons; leave name empty or 'Actions' and do not pin it. The ToolJet look ignores buttonDisplay.
authoringHints.checkboxSelection: For bulk actions (approve, export, assign, delete several rows) turn on showBulkSelector: the table draws a checkbox column with a select-all box in the header (the UI 2.0 checkbox in that look). Read components.<table>.selectedRows (the row objects) and selectedRowsId; put the bulk action in a ShadButton above the table whose text counts them ('Approve 3') and whose disabledState is {{!(components.<table>.selectedRows || []).length}}; onSelectionChanged fires on each change. Keep allowSelection on. After the action runs, refresh the data query (the selection clears with new data). A checkbox column is for acting on several rows; for opening one record, use onRowClicked.

serverSideDataFlow.reactiveReadRule: When page/count options reference Table or external-filter exposed state, prefer runOnDependencyChange=true so reads occur after the new state is published. Keep onPageLoad for initial hydration and onRefresh for explicit refresh.
serverSideDataFlow.initialPageGuard: pageIndex can be undefined when a page-load query first evaluates. For offset pagination use ((components.<table>.pageIndex || 1) - 1) * pageSize, or an equivalent nullish guard; the unguarded subtraction produces NaN and an empty table.
serverSideDataFlow.eventRule: With reactive reads, onPageChanged/onSearch/onSort/onFilterChanged and external-filter events should not also run those queries. Use them only for non-query effects such as resetting pageIndex to 1; duplicate wiring causes redundant or stale reads.

runtimeCompatibility.rule: For explicit static columns, keep table-level autogenerateColumns=true and useDynamicColumn=false. MCP normalizes these defaults because some ToolJet versions crash while generating column transformations when autogenerateColumns is false.

dataProjection.rule: With explicit columns and autogenerateColumns=true, bind data to a new object containing only visible and behavior-needed keys. A .map(r => r) identity map or {...r} spread is not a projection and can leak undeclared datasource fields.

hiddenDataColumns.rule: When a field is needed by row actions or selectedRow but must not display, keep it in Table data and declare it in columns with columnVisibility=false. This preserves the key while preventing autogenerateColumns from leaking it as a visible column.

inlineEditing.selection: selectedRow and rowData contain the original source row, not the pending inline edits. selectRowOnCellEdit does not change this contract.
inlineEditing.pendingRows: Read pending full rows with Object.values(components.<table>.dataUpdates || {}). dataUpdates and changeSet are objects keyed by row indexes, not database primary keys; updatedData contains all rows with edits merged.
inlineEditing.saveEvent: The native Save changes footer fires onBulkUpdate. Wire a supported mutation to that event before exposing the footer; an editable cell or visible Save control alone does not persist anything.
inlineEditing.perRowSave: For a per-row Save action, find the pending row by its stable primary key, not its filtered/sorted position. Use selectedRow only for identity; do not save selectedRow field values as if they were edited values. Hide the bulk footer when it has no separate working handler.
inlineEditing.validation: Validate edited numbers for finite, nonnegative values before writing; reject negative values, recompute derived status fields from the edited values, and refresh/reset edits only after confirmed success. Verify the saved value after reload.

rowActionButtons.catalogActionsMeaning: Top-level schema.actions are control-component runtime methods, not row-action buttons.
